title: arenaria nitida
intro: Arenaria nitida, commonly known as Rock Jasmine, is a flowering plant species native to the mountainous regions of the Mediterranean. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in reducing stress, improving sleep, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Arenaria nitida include its sedative, anxiolytic, and anti-anaphylactic effects, making it a potential natural remedy for anxiety disorders and allergic reactions. The bioactive constituents present in Arenaria nitida include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
